needs_you.name: Work survives a restart
needs_you.statement: TEST RESEARCH NOTE — invented for CLIVE's tests. Every job CLIVE starts should carry on after the server restarts, instead of being lost.

reasons.judgment: Three invented test notes agree, and it serves DEC-005: a change is only done once it is read back.
reasons.timing: It makes everything else safer, so it comes first.

needs_you.how_they_differ: Alpha wants every job kept; Beta only the ones that change the shop.

owner_view.means: If the server restarts halfway through something CLIVE is doing for you, it picks up where it left off.
owner_view.today: Proposals survive a restart, but a long read in progress starts again from nothing.
owner_view.after: A restart in the middle of a returns check finishes the check instead of dropping it.
owner_view.example: You ask CLIVE to check every open return while the server updates; today you ask again, after this it carries on.
owner_view.before_after: Before: ask again after a restart. After: it finishes by itself.
owner_view.notice: The first time the server restarts while CLIVE is busy.
